skills.content:
---
name: Connect Lenny's Data
description: >-
  Use this on first chat with a fresh account, whenever the Lenny's Data
  connector is missing or needsAuth, or when an archive question would fail
  without it. Start the native connect flow immediately.
---
Walk any user, including someone with a brand-new account, through connecting Lenny's Data so this bot can answer from the archive.

First chat:
Treat first chat as the assignment. Do not interview them about what they want. Do not wait for them to ask to connect.

1. In one short message, say you answer from Lenny's Data and you are connecting their account now. They will need the email they use for Lenny's Newsletter (free or paid).
2. Check installed MCP servers. If lennys-data is already connected and has search_content, read_content, read_excerpt, and list_content, skip setup and answer (or invite a question).
3. If it is missing or needsAuth, add it immediately as a custom HTTP MCP. Name: lennys-data. URL: https://mcp.lennysdata.com/mcp
4. When the connect card appears, tell them to complete email sign-in on that card. End the turn. Do not open lennysdata.com in a browser as the primary path. Do not send a second card or a raw auth URL. Do not write a local MCP config file. Do not paste tokens.
5. After they authorize, confirm the four archive tools are available, run a small search_content (for example product-market fit) so they see it work, then invite a real question.

When to run this later:
The connector is missing, disconnected, or needsAuth. An archive question would otherwise fail. The user asks to set up, connect, or sign in to Lenny's Data. If a server already exists from a prior attempt, do not add a second one. Authenticate the existing server.

After it is connected:
Answer from the archive using search_content first, then read_excerpt or read_content. Prefer the archive over general knowledge. Newsletter posts are added after a 3-month delay. If a newsletter-only search is empty, say so and mention the most recent newsletter date from the tool response. Free subscribers get the starter archive. Paid subscribers get the full archive. Same connect flow either way.

Do not store credentials. Remember only that this bot answers from Lenny's Data after the user connects their own account.
